offering_description.value: Provides integrated payment processing and software for consumer and business payments. Sells to auto lenders, credit unions, healthcare providers, and business-to-business vendors, embedding payment acceptance in their software and workflows. Revenue comes mainly from processing volume.

primary_products.value: payment processing platform; integrated payment software; bill pay and accounts payable automation software; virtual card payment tools

primary_services.value: payment processing; merchant services; loan and bill payment acceptance; accounts payable payment services

customer_segment.value: B2B: auto lenders, credit unions, consumer lenders, healthcare providers, B2B vendors and merchants

end_markets.value: consumer lending; auto finance; credit unions and banking; healthcare; business-to-business commerce

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees per payment processed, based on volume and transactions; service fees: fees for software, integration and related payment services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: payments technology platform integrated with clients' software, sold to lenders, healthcare and business clients; financial intermediary: processes card and ACH payments between payers and merchants via card networks and banks

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily United States, with some operations in Canada and the UK

specialization.value: related lines: consumer payments, business payments and integrated payment software for vertical clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales team selling to lenders, credit unions, healthcare and business clients; partners / resellers: software providers and ISV partners integrating Repay payments

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payment processing subject to card network rules, NACHA, PCI DSS, money transmission and consumer protection rules
